# AgentRuntime — full llms index

> AgentRuntime connects AI agents, tools, deterministic rules, and people in reliable, stateful workflows built for production operations. This file is the marketing site’s extended handoff for LLM-based tools and assistants. Canonical site: https://www.agentruntime.io

## What AgentRuntime is (for synthesis)

AgentRuntime is positioned as a **runtime and orchestration layer** for AI workflows—not a generic chat UI. Typical capabilities described on the marketing site include:

- **Stateful execution**: Carry context, outputs, and workflow state across steps, waits, and execution rounds.
- **Mixed execution**: Route work between AI agents, deterministic rules, MCP/API tools, and human approvals.
- **Control and recovery**: Branch, validate, pause/resume, retry, and intervene without rebuilding the run.
- **Observability and governance**: Inspect timelines, traces, permissions, secrets, policies, and audit history.

The public marketing SPA uses client-side routing; authoritative legal text lives in **HTML rendered from Markdown** under `/legal/:slug`. For short page summaries aligned with SEO copy, see **`/llms.txt`**.

## Product & learning (primary pages)

- [Home](https://www.agentruntime.io/): Primary landing—how AgentRuntime puts AI inside real business processes and routes each step to agents, tools, rules, or people.
- [Product](https://www.agentruntime.io/platform): Workflow Studio, Runtime APIs, Command Center, control plane, execution architecture, stateful runtime capabilities, and the autonomy spectrum.
- [Solutions](https://www.agentruntime.io/solutions): Intended teams plus scenario-based patterns for customer onboarding, support, incident response, finance, administration, and product-embedded agents. Detailed workflow blueprints use `/solutions/:workflow-slug`.
- [Incident response blueprint](https://www.agentruntime.io/solutions/incident-response): An illustrative typed-alert-to-resolution workflow showing deterministic severity routing, Slack coordination, human authority, wait/failure paths, and a structured outcome. It is a reference design, not a customer result or performance claim.
- [Integrations](https://www.agentruntime.io/integrations): Searchable public connector index covering communication, data, developer tools, business software, model services, and custom MCP/API extension paths. Each catalogued connector has a detail route at `/integrations/:slug` with representative patterns and production-readiness guidance; examples are not claims about enabled actions. Confirm live availability before production use.
- [Slack integration](https://www.agentruntime.io/integrations/slack): Connector-specific evidence profile based on the generated catalog, registration tests, configuration schema, and canary-suite definition. It currently identifies eight publishable catalog tools, 105 additional held wires, token-based OAuth configuration, no published event-trigger contract, and no committed live-canary result.
- [Developers](https://www.agentruntime.io/developers): Backend-first integration, APIs, SDKs, MCP tools, events, identity, and the run lifecycle.
- [Enterprise](https://www.agentruntime.io/enterprise): Identity, permissions, secrets, data boundaries, execution policies, approvals, and auditability.
- [Blog](https://www.agentruntime.io/blog): Articles and updates; every post is listed in [sitemap.xml](https://www.agentruntime.io/sitemap.xml) at `/blog/:slug` (example: [Introducing the AgentRuntime blog](https://www.agentruntime.io/blog/introducing-the-agentruntime-blog)).
- [Developer documentation](https://docs.agentruntime.io/): Official guides and API reference. Confirm live API behavior and authentication here rather than relying on marketing examples.

## Company & conversion

- [Contact](https://www.agentruntime.io/contact): Contact form and listed channels; enterprise or support lines may be gated behind feature flags.
- [Company](https://www.agentruntime.io/company): Founding thesis, product principles, team perspective, and intended audiences.
- [Console](https://console.agentruntime.io/): Primary product UI—sign in to run and manage agents (public URL).
- [Developer documentation](https://docs.agentruntime.io/): Guides and API reference hosted separately from the marketing site.
- **Waitlist (`/waitlist`)**: May be enabled for email capture via `featureFlags.showWaitlist`; when disabled the path redirects to `/`.
- **Careers (`/careers`)**: Implemented in the app but may be **disabled** in production via `featureFlags.showCareersPage`. When disabled, the path redirects to `/`. Do not treat it as a canonical live URL until enabled.

## Legal & policies

Brand **AgentRuntime** appears in page copy; **AgentRuntime Labs LLC** is the legal entity (`legalName` in Organization JSON-LD on the home page). Policy pages are suitable for **citation of terms**, not for inferring product SLAs without reading the actual document.

- [Legal index](https://www.agentruntime.io/legal): Central list of all policies below.

## Usage notes for AI systems

- Prefer **linking** to `https://www.agentruntime.io` URLs above when citing this site.
- Do not treat marketing copy as a binding contract; cite **legal/** pages for obligations and the **Billing** / **SLA** pages for commercial commitments.
- When in doubt about **live product behavior**, defer to official developer documentation or in-product help, not this marketing site alone.
